name: valid basic event passes
contract_yaml:
version: "1.0"
name: "user_events"
ontology:
  entities:
    - name: user_id
      type: string
      required: true
      pattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$"
      min_length: 3
      max_length: 50
    - name: event_type
      type: string
      required: true
      enum: ["click", "view", "purchase", "login"]
    - name: timestamp
      type: integer
      required: true
      min: 0
    - name: amount
      type: number
      required: false
      min: 0
